artifacts.name: v0.8 → v1.0 Migration Notes
artifacts.description: OperatorOS v0.8.x → OperatorOS Platform v1.0 migration procedure. v0.8 importer contract is unchanged between rc1 and v1.0.

artifacts.name: Architecture Deltas
artifacts.description: D-001..D-006 deviations from the frozen architecture, carried forward from rc1. No new deltas introduced by v1.0 public-readiness work.

artifacts.name: v1.0 Release-Bundle Manifest (self)
artifacts.description: Self-referential top-level manifest enumerating every v1.0 release artifact with its SHA-256. The self-reference SHA-256 is the value of the file after the self-entry was added; a verifying consumer should recompute the hash on disk and accept that it equals this value if and only if the surrounding context matches.

artifacts.name: v1.0 Quality-Gate Evidence
artifacts.description: Consolidated evidence for all 11 quality gates (format, lint, typecheck, test:coverage, build, contracts:verify, architecture:check, docs:build, security:scan, licenses:report, sbom) plus the NFR matrix.

artifacts.name: v1.0 Portfolio Asset Index
artifacts.description: Catalog of candidate visual, narrative, and reference assets: landing page, architecture diagrams, public docs, scoped local source reference, project root files, and this bundle.

artifacts.name: v1.0 Manifest Verifier
artifacts.description: Standalone Node.js script that recomputes every artifact's SHA-256 and compares it to the value recorded in this MANIFEST.json. Exits 0 if all 9 non-self references verify; the self-reference is tolerated with an explicit drift warning.
